summary: This note from a list of NCIS: Los Angeles characters describes the character Nate and his relationship with recurring character Rose Shwartz, which is an unconsummated mutual attraction left unexplored after actor Peter Cambor left the main cast. It also covers Nate's reassignment to the Middle East to investigate a Yemen-based Islamic militant group, which ended with the episode "Harm's Way", after which his current assignment is undisclosed but he remains in the Middle East for now.
one_line: Describes the NCIS: Los Angeles character Nate, his unexplored attraction to Rose Shwartz, and his Middle East assignment after Peter Cambor left the main cast.
key_facts: Nate and recurring character Rose Shwartz share an unconsummated mutual attraction.
The attraction between Nate and Rose Shwartz has not been explored further.
The attraction was not explored further because Peter Cambor is no longer a member of the main cast.
Peter Cambor's departure as a main cast member coincides with Nate's reassignment to the Middle East.
Nate was reassigned to the Middle East to investigate an Islamic militant group based in Yemen.
The Middle East assignment concluded in the episode "Harm's Way".
After the conclusion of that mission in "Harm's Way", Nate's current assignment is undisclosed.
Nate is known to be remaining in the Middle East for the time being.
